401: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am devoted to the Guru, for by meeting him I have made remembering the eternal Lord the aim of my life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ. ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Good and bad omens cling to the one in whose mind God does not dwell.
ਤਿਸੁ. ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
The messenger of death does not come near one who, joined in remembrance, becomes dear to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ. ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Of all the good deeds, charity, chanting and austerity, repeating the Name is the highest.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Whoever repeats God's Name with his tongue has his life's aim fulfilled. ॥3॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ; ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ. ਬੀਆ ॥
Their fears are destroyed, their wandering and attachment gone, and no one seems a stranger to them,
ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
O Nanak, whom the supreme Lord Himself protects; no pain touches them again. ॥4॥18॥120॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ; ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ. ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
I long to gain every comfort by remembering God, but I do not know whether I please Him in His presence.
ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ. ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ; ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
There is one Giver and all the world begs from Him; to whom else could I go? ॥1॥
When I beg from anyone else I feel ashamed,
ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for the one Master is king over all beings; whom could I count His equal? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ. ਰਹਿ ਭਿ, ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
I rise and sit down again, yet cannot stay without Him; I search and search for His sight.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ. ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ, ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ. ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
His dwelling stayed hard to reach even for Brahma and the like, and for Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan and Sanat Kumar. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
He is beyond reach, a fathomless ocean whose depth no one grasps; His worth cannot be found, and I cannot price Him.
ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ. ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
I have sought the refuge of the true Guru, the great being, and I worship the true Guru. ॥3॥
ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
When the Master becomes kind and merciful to someone, He cuts the noose of attachment from his neck.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
Says Nanak: if I find the company of the holy, then I will not come into birth again. ॥4॥1॥121॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ; ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Now I sing His praise within, keep it in mind while dealing with the world outside, and sing it sleeping and waking.
ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ. ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Those who trade in God's Name have given me the Name as provisions for the journey, to go with me. ॥1॥
Every other support I have wholly forgotten.
ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ; ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The perfect Guru gave me the gift of the Name, and I have made it my life's support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ. ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ; ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
I sing His praise in pain and in comfort too, and keep Him in my heart as I walk the road.
ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ; ਮੋਰੀ. ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The Guru has made the Name firm in my mind, and it has quenched my thirst. ॥2॥
ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ. ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ; ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
By day and by night and with every breath I sing His praise with my tongue,
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
for in the company of the holy comes the faith that God stays with us in life and in death. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord, give Your servant Nanak this gift: that I may receive the dust of Your saints' feet and keep You in my heart,
ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ. ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ; ਮਸਤਕੁ. ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
hear Your praise with my ears, see You with my eyes, and keep my forehead at the Guru's feet. ॥4॥2॥122॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ; ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ. ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
O mind, the son, wife and goods you take to be lasting are guests for two days only.
402: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ. ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Son, wife, house and all its goods: all attachment to them is false. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ. ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
O mind, why do you cry "ah, ah" in delight at this display?
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ. ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ; ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ. ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Look closely: it is like a mountain of smoke; worship God alone and take that profit. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ. ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ; ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ. ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
The world is like clothes worn on the body, which grow old in two or four days.
ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
How far can one run along a wall? In the end its last edge comes. ॥2॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ. ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ; ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
Life is like a tank of water made ready: salt dissolves the moment it falls in.
ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ; ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ. ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
When the supreme Lord's order comes, one rises and departs that very instant. ॥3॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ; ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
O mind, you walk and sit within your allotted span, and draw each breath by that reckoning.
ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ. ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਉਬਰੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
O Nanak, ever sing God's praise; those who take the shelter of the true Guru's feet are saved. ॥4॥1॥123॥
ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ. ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ; ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
Every crooked thing of mine came straight, and my wicked enemies became friends,
ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ; ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ. ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
the jewel of the Guru's wisdom shone in my darkness, and my soiled intellect became clean. ॥1॥
When the Lord of the world showed me His grace,
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I met the true Guru, and as its fruit received the wealth of spiritual joy and God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ; ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
No one knew me, a worthless one; now I am known in all the worlds.
ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ. ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ; ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
I was not allowed to sit beside anyone; now all people serve my feet. ॥2॥
ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ. ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ; ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
I went searching for every half-penny; now all my mind's craving is quenched.
ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ. ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
I could not bear a single harsh word; through the company of the holy my mind is now cool. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਜੀਹ. ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
Which of His virtues can my one tongue tell? He is beyond reach, beyond reach, beyond reach.
ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
O Nanak, say: O Lord, I, Your servant, have come to Your refuge; make me the servant of Your servants' servants. ॥4॥2॥124॥
ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ. ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ; ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ. ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
O foolish mind, you are slow, so slow towards profit, but run quickly towards loss.
ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ. ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
You do not buy the cheap goods, O sinner, but stay bound by the debt of vices. ॥1॥
O true Guru, my hope is in You.
ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ. ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O supreme Lord, this is my only shelter: Your Name purifies the fallen. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ. ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
You listen to foul songs and are carried away, but grow lazy in taking the Name,
ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ; ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
you are eager at the thought of slander; you have understood everything back to front. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ. ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
Others' wealth, others' bodies, slander of others: maddened by greed, you eat what should not be eaten.
ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ. ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ; ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
You feel no love for the righteous way that lasts, and hearing the truth irritates you. ॥3॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
O Master, merciful to the meek, O kind Lord, Your devotees lean on Your Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ; ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
O Nanak, say: Lord, I have come longingly to Your refuge; make me Your own and keep my honour. ॥4॥3॥125॥
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ; ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
The unfortunate person is wrapped up in false companions and bound by attachment to Maya;
ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ. ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
the place he must go to never enters his mind, and he stays blind in pride. ॥1॥
O my mind, why do you not turn away from Maya and worship God?
ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ, ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You live in a hut of unbaked clay, and all the diseases of vice cling to you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ, ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ; ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ. ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
Saying "mine, mine", his day and night pass, and moment by moment his life wears away.
403: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ; ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
As the fly is caught by the taste of sweetness, so he stays caught in false business and its stench. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
He is engrossed in lust, anger, greed and attachment, the pleasures of the senses.
ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
When the Creator sends him round the cycle of births, he wanders through births again and again. ॥3॥
ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ. ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ, ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
When God, destroyer of the poor's pain, becomes kind, he meets the Guru and gains every comfort.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ; ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ. ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
Says Nanak: I meditate day and night, and He has driven every vice out of me. ॥4॥
Only in this way can one repeat the Name of the Creator, the timeless Lord.
ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
The one on whom God, destroyer of the poor's pain, is kind is freed from the pains of birth and death. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥4॥4॥126॥
ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ; ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
For a moment's taste of lust, O blind one, you suffer pain for millions of days.
ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
You enjoy pleasures for a moment or two, then regret again and again. ॥1॥
O one blinded by lust, remember the sovereign Lord.
ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ; ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your day of departure is drawing near. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ; ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ. ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
Seeing for a moment the gourd, bitter as swallow-wort and neem, you are led astray.
ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ. ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ; ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
Company with another's wife is like company with a snake. ॥2॥
ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ; ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
For Maya, which turns enemy in the end, you commit sins, and the real thing is left lying aside.
ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ; ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
You keep company with those you must leave, and are at enmity with the Friend. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ. ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ; ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
The whole world is caught in this way; he alone escapes whose protector is the perfect Guru.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ; ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
Says Nanak: such a one crosses the world-ocean, and his body becomes pure. ॥4॥5॥127॥
ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ. ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
O Lord, You see whatever people do in secret, yet the foolish and ignorant deny it.
ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
They are seized for their own deeds, and afterwards they regret. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
My Lord knows every deed of yours before anything else.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ. ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ; ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O you robbed by delusion, you hide from Him and secretly do as your mind pleases. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ. ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
To whatever He attaches them, to that they are attached; what can any creature do?
ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
Forgive, O supreme Lord and Master; Nanak is ever a sacrifice to You. ॥2॥6॥128॥
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ. ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
God Himself keeps His servant's honour and Himself has him repeat the Name.
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Wherever the servant has some task, there the Lord hastens at once. ॥1॥
To His servant the Lord shows Himself close at hand,
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for whatever the servant asks of the Master is granted at once. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the servant who pleases his Lord.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ, ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
Hearing of his glory the mind blossoms, O Nanak, and one comes to touch his feet. ॥2॥7॥129॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ. ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ. ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
The actor shows many kinds of guise, yet stays just as he is.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸੁਖਹਿ. ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
So a person, caught in wandering, roams through many births and never enters peace. ॥1॥
404: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ. ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
O saints, my friends and companions, apart from God all is perishable.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who sings God's praises in the company of the holy has won this precious human birth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
This Maya of three qualities is made by God; tell me, how can it be crossed?
ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ. ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Its whirlpools are fathomless and hard to cross; only through the Guru's word can one get across. ॥2॥
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ; ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
O Nanak, one who searched and reflected came to know this reality:
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ. ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
remembering the Name, the priceless treasure, the mind becomes a pearl and is won over. ॥3॥1॥130॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ. ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
Since by the Guru's grace He came to dwell in my mind, whatever I ask I receive.
ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
This mind is sated by the colour of the Name, and I no longer run anywhere else. ॥1॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
My Master is highest of all; night and day I sing His praise.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ; ਤਿਸ ਤੇ. ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In an instant He creates and destroys; O mind, I want you to stay in awe of Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
When I see my Lord and Master within, I give no other support a place in my mind.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ. ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
Since the Lord Himself honoured His servant Nanak, I have wiped out wandering and fear and keep inscribing the Name. ॥2॥2॥131॥
ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ. ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ; ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ. ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
The vices crush people of all four castes and make the six garbs dance on their palms.
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ; ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ. ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
The handsome, the shapely, the elegant and the wise: the five have enticed and deceived them all. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ; ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Rare is one so strong that, meeting the Guru, he has slain the five warriors.
ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ. ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ. ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He who has slain the five and torn them to shreds is the perfect one in this world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ. ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ. ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Their clan is mighty, they are not controlled and do not flee; their army is strong and stubborn.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
Says Nanak: only the one who stays in the shelter of the company of the holy has trampled them down. ॥2॥3॥132॥
ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ. ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ; ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ. ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God's praise is the finest, loveliest thing for the soul; all other tastes are insipid. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ, ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ. ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
It is full of virtue and sweetness; the sages versed in the six systems count nothing else of use. ॥1॥
ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
It destroys the poison of the senses, is of wondrous taste, beyond telling, and brings stillness of mind; O Nanak, it is drunk in the company of the holy. ॥2॥4॥133॥
ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਿਮਖ, ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has never let the dear Word, the stream of nectar, slip from my mind even for an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ. ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ. ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
It dyes one in the Creator's love; through it come His sight, the touch of His feet, joy and delight. ॥1॥
ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ, ਹਰਿ ਦਮ. ਨਹ ਜਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
Dwelling on it an instant brings one to the Guru, and kept with every breath death's fear cannot touch; O Nanak, wear it at your throat, a garland on your heart. ॥2॥5॥134॥
The company of the holy is a lovely blessing. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ, ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
There, every watch, moment and instant, God's praises are sung and spoken. ॥1॥
ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Walking, sitting, sleeping, one praises God; He dwells in mind and body, and one stays joined to His feet. ॥2॥
ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ. ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
O Nanak, say: I am without virtue, You my Master are full of it; I have learnt to seek Your refuge. ॥3॥6॥135॥
405: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ; ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Give up all your cleverness and remember the formless transcendent Lord.
ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Without the Name of the eternal One, every other cleverness proves worthless. ॥1॥
Know that God to be always with you;
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
this is understood by the Guru's grace, by staying in the love of the one Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Only the shelter of the One has the power to carry you across; there is no other support.
ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
Sing God's praises always, and the terrible world-ocean is crossed. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
The round of birth and death is ended, spiritual death does not come near, and no pain can touch you.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
But only that person gains the Name, the treasure of all virtues, on whom God Himself has mercy. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ; ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
The One is the only shelter, the One the only support, the One the only strength in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
O Nanak, the Name should be repeated in the company of the holy; there is none but God. ॥4॥1॥136॥
ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
This soul, mind, body and breath, and all the tasty things, are given by God.
ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
God is the true kin of the poor, the giver of spiritual life, able to protect those who seek His shelter. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
O my mind, keep remembering God's Name.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ; ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone helps you and stays with you here and hereafter; keep your attention on the One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
To cross the world-ocean people study the Vedas and Shastras,
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
and perform many set rites and religious deeds, but remembering the Name stands above them all. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
Whoever meets the divine true Guru has lust, anger and pride destroyed.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Hold the Name firmly within and worship God; the service of God is the good work. ॥3॥
ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
O merciful Lord, I have taken the shelter of Your feet; You give honour to one without honour.
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
You are the support of my soul and breath; God is Nanak's strength. ॥4॥2॥137॥
ਡੋਲਿ. ਡੋਲਿ. ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Without the company of the Guru, wavering in faith again and again, you have suffered great pain.
ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
Now earn the profit: taste God's Name and enjoy union with the one transcendent Lord. ॥1॥
God's Name should be repeated always.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With every breath remember that God, and give up love of any other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
That God is the root of all creation and all-powerful; He Himself gives spiritual life.
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
Give up all other cleverness and remember God all eight watches. ॥2॥
ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ; ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
The highest, unreachable and infinite Lord is your true friend, companion, helper and comrade;
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
keep His lovely lotus feet in your heart, for He is the true support of the soul. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
O God, transcendent Lord, have mercy, that I may always sing Your virtues and praise.
ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
In Your praise are all comforts and great honour; Nanak gains spiritual life by remembering Your Name. ॥4॥3॥138॥
ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ. ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Keep me at the effort, my Master, so that, beholding You in the Guru's company, I strive to repeat Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
O God, dye my mind with the colour of Your Name; You Yourself dye it in Your love. ॥1॥
O God, I may keep repeating Your Name in my mind
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if You become my helper and in mercy come to dwell in my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
O my beloved, may the longing to see You stay in me as I hear Your Name again and again;
406: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ; ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
have mercy on Your lowly servant and fulfil this wish, this need of mine. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
My body and wealth are Your gift and You are my Master; nothing is in our power.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
As You keep us, so we live; we eat whatever You give. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ; ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Bathing in the dust of the feet of God's servants removes the sins of birth after birth;
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ. ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
through loving devotion every fear and false notion is destroyed, and O Nanak, God is felt ever present. ॥4॥4॥139॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
O unreachable Lord, You are beyond the reach of the senses; only he sees You whose destiny awakens on his forehead.
ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
On whom the merciful Lord casts His glance of mercy, the true Guru grants the gift of the Name. ॥1॥
O true Guru, You have saved even the Kali age,
ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ. ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ; ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and all who were filthy and foolish have come to Your service. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
O God, You Yourself create all the world, You support it, and You pervade it all;
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Dharam Raj is astonished that the whole world is falling at Your feet. ॥2॥
ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ. ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ. ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The Sat, Treta and Dvapar ages are called good, yet the Kali age is the best of all ages,
ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ; ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ. ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
for the hand that does a deed is the hand that reaps it; no one is seized in another's place. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ, ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ; ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
O Lord, You do just what Your devotees ask of You; this has been Your nature from the beginning.
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
With palms joined Nanak begs this gift: O Lord, grant him the sight of Your saints. ॥4॥5॥140॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
have carried the virtueless across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ. ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ; ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Those who were harsh of nature, wicked and foul-spoken became pure in Your company. ॥1॥
ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ. ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Those who wandered through births and lay in hell, You saved their families, line upon line. ॥2॥
ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ; ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Those whom no one knew and no one respected became honoured at God's door. ॥3॥
ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ, ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
O Nanak, say: to whom can I liken You, what praise can I give? I am a sacrifice to You every moment. ॥4॥1॥141॥
Those crazed by Maya stay asleep in heedlessness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ. ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ; ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
Drunk on attachment to family and the tastes of the senses, they lay claim to what is false. ॥1॥
ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ. ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ; ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
They crave things that will not stay, like the joys of a dream, and in mind and speech call them lasting. ॥2॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ; ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ. ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
The Name that gives spiritual life is the one thing that stays with them, yet they grasp not a grain of its secret. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
O Nanak, those whom God in mercy keeps in the company of the holy remain in His shelter. ॥4॥2॥142॥
All I want is that love of the Beloved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ. ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ; ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
Gold, pearls, great pearls, diamonds and rubies: I want none of them, none at all. ॥1॥
ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
No kingdom, no wealth, no power, no tasty food: I want nothing at all. ॥2॥
407: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥ ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪੩॥
In the refuge of the saints' feet and bowing to them I find comfort upon comfort; O Nanak, the burning of craving is removed when the Beloved's love is found. ॥3॥3॥143॥
The Guru has shown You to me with these eyes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ, ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
O enticing Lord, here and hereafter, in every body and every heart, I see only You. ॥1॥
ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ. ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ; ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
O beautiful Lord, You alone are the Creator, the root of all the world; You alone support all creation. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ. ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
O Nanak, say: I touch the feet of Your saints and am a sacrifice to their sight; through them one rests for ever in spiritual bliss. ॥3॥4॥144॥
One who gains God's priceless Name
stays in stillness of mind and lives at ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ. ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
God is the companion ever with us and never leaves, yet no cleverness can grasp Him and He has no equal. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ. ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
He is my beloved, my brother, my father and my mother; He is the support of His devotees. ॥2॥
ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
O Nanak, the Guru made the indescribable Lord known and through the Guru I met Him; this is God's wondrous play. ॥3॥5॥145॥
Keep me always in Your devotion.
O my Master, I have come to You with longing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ. ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Keep Your feet in my heart and give me Your precious Name, so that my life bears fruit. ॥1॥
ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ. ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Keep me in the company of Your saints: this is liberation for me, and this my way of life. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
O Nanak, say: Lord, diving into Your virtues may I remember Your Name and rest in stillness of mind. ॥3॥6॥146॥
and God's saints attain union with them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ; ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
Shedding self-conceit, they serve Him and sing His virtues with great delight. ॥1॥
ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ. ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
Their hope rests on the One alone, they thirst for His sight, and nothing else pleases them. ॥2॥
ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ, ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
O Nanak, say: it is Your mercy, Lord; what power have poor creatures? I am a sacrifice to You. ॥3॥7॥147॥
Keep remembering the One in your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ. ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Remember the Name and keep it in your heart; without Him there is no one. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ, ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Come, let us stay in God's shelter and receive all fruits; there every sorrow departs. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ. ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
O Nanak, say: the Creator Lord gives to all beings and dwells in every body. ॥3॥8॥148॥
One who forgets God has died a spiritual death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ. ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ. ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
One who remembers the Name obtains all fruits; that person lives at ease. ॥1॥
ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ, ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਬਾਧਿਓ. ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
One who forgets the Name may call himself king, yet his deeds only feed pride; he stays bound like the parrot clinging to the tube, deluded that it saves him. ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
Says Nanak: whoever meets the true Guru becomes steady in spiritual life. ॥3॥9॥149॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਓਹੁ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
That love stays ever new which remains fixed on one's own beloved Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
One who pleases God does not come into birth again; one granted God's love and devotion stays absorbed in His love. ॥1॥
408: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
God is met only by handing over this mind; O Nanak, pray: Lord, show Your mercy, that Nanak may receive Your Name. ॥2॥1॥150॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ. ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meet me, my beloved Lord; without You nothing brings peace to my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Many performed the rites the Simritis and Shastras prescribe, but without Your sight, O God, there is no bliss. ॥1॥
ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ, ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ, ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
People grew weary of fasts, vows and self-restraint; O Nanak, in the Guru's shelter the mind dwells absorbed in God. ॥2॥2॥151॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ; ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
A person sleeps in vices and the intoxication of Maya; no understanding of life's right way comes to him.
ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ. ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ; ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Only when Death seizes him by the hair and lifts him up does he come to his senses. ॥1॥
ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ; ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ, ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
Caught in greed for Maya and the pleasures of the senses, they steal others' wealth and wound their hearts;
ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ. ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਅਸੁਰ. ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
drunk on pride in what leaves them in a moment, these cruel people do not understand. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ; ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਡੋਰਾ ॥
The Vedas and Shastras teach and the saints cry out, but the one made deaf does not listen.
ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ. ਮੂਕਾ; ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
When he has lost life's game completely and comes to the end, the fool repents in his mind. ॥2॥
ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ. ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ. ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
He keeps paying penalties for nothing and is not accepted in God's presence;
ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ. ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ; ਸੋਇ. ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
the work that would win honour at God's door he never does. ॥3॥
ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ, ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
When the Guru showed me what the world is like, I began to sing the praise of the One;
ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ; ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
then, giving up pride, other supports and cleverness, Nanak came to God's shelter. ॥4॥1॥152॥
One who takes up the trade in God's Name
ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ, ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ; ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ, ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
sings His virtues, wins the saints' favour and meets the beloved Lord; within him five kinds of instrument seem to play. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ, ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ; ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
One who by God's grace gains stillness of mind and sees Him is dyed in His love for ever.
ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ, ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Through the service the Guru taught he gains the Master's love, and the colour of the dear Lord's love takes hold. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ, ਨਹੀ ਆਏ; ਸਹਜਾਏ. ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One who fixes the Guru's wisdom in his mind blossoms, does not enter births again, gains stillness and finds the treasure of the Name within.
ਸਭ ਤਜੀ; ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
He gives up all the cravings of his mind.
ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
It has been long, so very long since I saw You; a great thirst for Your sight has risen in my mind.
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ. ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
O Lord, show me Your sight; tell me Yourself how I may see You.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ. ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ; ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
O Nanak, pray: I, Your lowly one, have come to Your shelter; take me into Your embrace. ॥2॥2॥153॥
Rare is the one who breaks down the hard fortress
ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ; ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and holds his mind back from hopes, craving, deceit, attachment and wandering. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ; ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
Rare is the one who rids himself of the diseases of lust, anger, greed and pride. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ; ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
In the company of the saints, absorbed in the colour of the Name, I sing God's virtues;
at every moment I meditate on God,
and so I overcome the wall of wandering and pull it down.
O Nanak, to be saved from these ills I have only the treasure of the Name. ॥2॥3॥154॥
Give up lust, anger and greed.
Keep remembering God's Name in your mind;
through remembering God every task bears fruit. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
409: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ. ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
Give up pride, attachment, vice and falsehood, and remember God always,
O mind, and stay in the shelter of the saints. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ, ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਜਾਗੁ ॥
Meditate on the feet of God, Sustainer of the earth, kind to the meek, purifier of the fallen, and stay awake.
O Nanak, say: worship God and your destiny will awaken. ॥2॥4॥155॥
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ; ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ. ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O friend, the blissful Lord has shown me this play of the world, with its joy, sorrow and detachment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ. ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ; ਖਿਨਹੂੰ. ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
In one moment fears crowd in, in another there is fearlessness, in another one rises and runs after things;
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ. ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ; ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
in one moment pleasures are enjoyed, in another they are abandoned. ॥1॥
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ. ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ; ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
Here yoga, austerities and many kinds of worship go on, there other wanderings;
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
O Nanak, somewhere in a moment God shows mercy through the company of the holy and gives the colour of His love. ॥2॥5॥156॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O friend, keep remembering God always,
and build love for Him in your mind.
ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ. ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Keep in your heart what the Guru has told you.
Break your love for others and turn your mind away from them.
ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ, ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In this way, O friend, the Beloved is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O friend, in the world-ocean lies the mud of attachment;
caught in it, the foot cannot walk towards God.
The foolish man has his foot stuck in it
ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ. ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
O friend, only when one takes God's shelter does it come free. ॥1॥
Make your mind steady, steady against Maya,
so steady that forest and home seem alike.
Keep the one Beloved within your heart,
and outwardly go about many kinds of work;
in this way rule and practise yoga as well.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ. ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
Says Nanak: O friend, this is a path apart from the world. ॥2॥1॥157॥
O my mind, hold a longing for the One.
Joined to the Guru's feet, stay always in God's remembrance.
Grow firm in knowing the Guru's teaching.
Serve and worship at the Guru's feet.
ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Then, O my mind, God is met through the Guru's grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
when God is seen pervading every place,
then the dread of fearsome Death is lifted,
a place is found at the root of the world-tree, the Lord's feet,
One whose destiny awakens on his forehead
crosses beyond the danger of the fire of vices,
finds a place in his own true home,
ever enjoys God's Name, the finest of all tastes,
and his thirst and hunger for Maya are gone;
O Nanak, say: O my mind, he stays absorbed in stillness of mind. ॥2॥2॥158॥
O my mind, the Name of God, Master of all virtues,
should be repeated absorbed in the current of stillness.
Taking the Guru's shelter, utter His virtues with your tongue.
Listen, this is the way to escape the vices,
ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but, O my mind, it is gained only by great good fortune. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The sages and seers keep searching for that God,
who is the Master of all beings,
who is hard to find in this world wrapped in Maya,
and who, O my mind, fulfils every hope. ॥1॥
O mind, that God should be served and worshipped,
410: The One whose true form cannot be told and whose secret cannot be found:
who never perishes, and is neither born nor dies.
One who comes to know Him deeply through the Guru,
O Nanak, O my mind, his mind settles for good in His remembrance. ॥2॥3॥159॥
O my mind, grasp the support of the one Lord,
and keep reciting the Guru's word.
Find within your own mind the Lord, the treasure of all virtues.
O my mind, in this way one stays absorbed in spiritual bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who, while doing his work, stays untouched by attachment to Maya
crosses the world-ocean that is so hard to cross,
if he remains the dust of everyone's feet.
If I too keep praising the fearless Lord,
all my anxieties will be wiped away.
O my mind, may you receive this teaching of the true Guru. ॥1॥
One who gains the joy of God's Name:
ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
no pain ever comes near him.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
One who keeps listening to God's praises
is honoured by everyone in the world.
That person alone, born into the world, has a fruitful life,
O Nanak, O my mind, who has become dear to God. ॥2॥4॥160॥
Meeting together, we should sing God's praises;
so the highest state of spiritual life is attained.
One who is pierced through by that taste of praise
gains, as it were, all the powers of the adepts.
One who stays alert at all times against the attacks of vices,
O Nanak, O my mind, becomes greatly fortunate. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
We should wash the feet of the saints, giving up self and seeking their refuge;
so the mind's evil thinking is removed.
Remain the dust of the feet of God's servants,
and no pain can take hold of you.
Stay in the refuge of the devotees,
and the round of birth and death will not remain.
Those become steady in spiritual life
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
who keep repeating God's Name, O my mind. ॥1॥
You alone are my friend and companion;
fix Your Name firmly within me.
The Lord without whom there is no other true friend:
keep remembering Him alone in your mind.
He should not be forgotten even for the blink of an eye,
for without His remembrance life does not pass in peace.
I am a sacrifice to the Guru, for by his grace
O Nanak, my mind repeats the Name. ॥2॥5॥161॥
You are the Creator of the whole world;
I see no other with such power apart from You.
O Lord, whatever You do is what comes to pass.
That person alone can rest in bliss and stillness of mind,
and in his mind alone courage takes hold,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who, O my mind, falls at the Lord's door. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By staying in the Guru's company,
that way of living is learned in full.
When pride comes to an end within a person,
from that moment all the mind's sufferings go.
O Lord of the world, and keep my honour, for I have sought Your refuge, O my mind. ॥1॥
This alone should be known as the root of happiness:
to accept as sweet whatever God does.
No one at all appears bad
to one who becomes the dust of the saints' feet.
The one whom the Lord Himself saves from vices
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
drinks the life-giving nectar of God's Name, O my mind. ॥2॥
One who has no helper at all:
if he seeks God's refuge, that God becomes his protector.
God knows what is in every heart;
He understands every wish of every being.
Save us, beings who have fallen into vices:
O Nanak, my mind makes this prayer at God's door. ॥3॥6॥162॥
O traveller, come into the world for only a few days,
listen carefully to this message. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
